header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Rao Faisal Ali, advocate for the petitioners
Mr. Sabir Hussain, D.A.G a/w ASI Muhammad Ismail, FIA Crime Circle,
Mr. Mir Parvez Akhtar Talpur, advocate files Vakalatnama on behalf of
body: respondents Nos.6 to 11, which is taken on record. Incharge/Deputy Director, NCCIA, CCRC Hyderabad, files statement wherein he submitted that complaint of the petitioner has now been entertained.

In view of such circumstances, counsel for the petitioner seeks disposal of the instant petition by submitting that NCCIA be directed to act strictly in accordance with law. Order accordingly. Petition is disposed of.
